data.name: Khizrullah
data.gender_notes: Khizrullah is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Khizrullah is derived from the Arabic words 'Khizr' meaning helper or assistant, and 'Allah' meaning God. In Islamic tradition, Prophet Khizr is considered a helper or guide of Allah, who is mentioned in the Quran and the Hadith. The name Khizrullah carries the meaning “helper of Allah” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Khizrullah usually hope their child will grow to embody helper of allah and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A reminder of the divine assistance and guidance that we all receive from Allah.
data.etymology: Khizrullah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “helper of Allah.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Khizrullah total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: خضراللہ
in_arabic.meaning: خضر النبي المعروف بالخضر عليه السلام اسم الله تعالى
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم مشتق من اسم النبي الخضر عليه السلام و الله تعالى، يعني الأخضر الذي يدل على الحياة و الخصب و النمو، و يرتبط بالسعادة و الفرح، و يعتبر من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني روحانية و دينية عميقة في التراث الإسلامي

in_urdu.name: خضراللہ
in_urdu.meaning: خضر نبی کا نام اللہ تعالیٰ کے ساتھ
in_urdu.long_meaning: خضراللہ نام خضر نبی علیہ السلام اور اللہ تعالیٰ کے نام سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے سبز رنگ جو زندگی، افزائش اور نمو کی نشاندہی کرتا ہے، اور خوشی اور مسرت سے وابستہ ہے، یہ نام اسلامی روایت میں 심오 روحانی اور دینی اہمیت رکھتا ہے

in_hindi.name: खिज़रुल्लाह
in_hindi.meaning: खिज़र नबी और अल्लाह का नाम साथ में
in_hindi.long_meaning: खिज़रुल्लाह नाम खिज़र नबी और अल्लाह के नाम से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है हरा रंग जो जीवन, वृद्धि और विकास को दर्शाता है, और खुशी और आनंद से जुड़ा हुआ है, यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में 심오 आध्यात्मिक और धार्मिक महत्व रखता है

It holds profound spiritual and religious significance in Islamic tradition, reflecting a connection to divine guidance and blessings. Historically, Prophet Khidr is known for his wisdom and guidance, as referenced in the Quran.

data.cultural_impact: Prophet Khizr is revered in Islamic tradition and is known for his significant role as a helper or guide sent by Allah to assist Prophet Moses (Musa). The story of Prophet Khizr and Prophet Moses is narrated in several Hadiths and is a source of inspiration for many Muslims. This name carries the cultural significance of unwavering faith in Allah's guidance and the importance of being a helper to others.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Khizrullah holds deep spiritual significance as it is a constant reminder that Allah sends helpers and guides to us in times of need. It is a name that embodies faith, patience, and trust in Allah's plan. Prophet Khizr's story demonstrates the importance of being obedient to Allah and seeking knowledge and wisdom to lead a virtuous life. This name resonates with those who strive to be close to Allah, seeking His guidance and help in all aspects of life.

historical_references.reference: Ibn Battuta's travel account mentions a holy man named Khizr Ibn Allah, whom he met during his travels in the Indian subcontinent around 1333 CE. According to the travel account, this Khizr was a local saint revered for his knowledge and ability to perform miracles.

Al-Biruni, a 11th century Persian scholar, wrote about the veneration of a saint named Khizr Ibn Allah by the people of Sindh (present-day Pakistan) during his explorations in India. He described this saint as a healer and a protector of travelers, who was believed to have the power to prevent shipwrecks and ensure safe journeys.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name 'Khizrullah' is of Islamic origin, meaning 'Allah's helper' or 'Allah's servant'. It is commonly used in the context of Sufism, a mystical branch of Islam, where Khizr (Khidr in Arabic) is revered as a wise and helpful guide on the spiritual journey. Khizrullah can be found in various modern contexts, particularly on social media platforms such as Instagram, Reddit, and YouTube. On Instagram, users may post images of shrines or artwork dedicated to Khizr, accompanied by captions expressing devotion or spiritual reflections. On Reddit, there are dedicated subreddits for discussions about Sufism and Khizr, and users may ask questions or share personal experiences. On YouTube, there are numerous videos featuring stories about Khizr and Sufi practices. These platforms reflect the growing interest in Islamic spirituality, Middle Eastern culture, and Sufism, and provide a space for individuals to connect, learn, and share their experiences with others.
